g.text: Incident coordination between the parties: who notifies whom, and the clocks
This syntax is deprecated, you must add <<#FEF2F2>> at the end of the line, after the ';'
Alert from the SIEM, or a report from a party
(a data user must report its own breach at once, Art. 61)
the connector or the SPE session
an ADR where a decision changed
Likely risk to the persons' rights?
Revokes the permit, stops the processing
immediately if a GDPR breach is possible (Art. 63(2))
Corrective action where an SPE audit
Loses access to the SPE until
Informs the affected holders in parallel
Controller: access body (SPE, permits) or holder (its data)
The clocks are owned by role: the controller owns the GDPR ones,
the operator the NIS2 ones, the access body the EHDS ones. The
incident procedure names a person and a deputy for each lane; the
tabletop exercise before go-live walks this diagram once.
